description: Bet Slip Layout Improvements - Full height modal, sticky bottom section with stake/submit, per-bet stakes for singles mode, remove quick-pick buttons. IMPORTANT: Maintain the existing dark sports-betting theme styling (Theme.swift).

userStories.title: Change Bet Slip to Full Height Modal
userStories.description: As a player, I want the bet slip to open to full height so I can see all my selections without scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Locate where BetSlipSheet presentation detents are configured (in GamesView.swift)
Change .presentationDetents([.medium, .large]) to .presentationDetents([.large])
Bet slip now opens to full modal height (100% of stacked modal)
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Simple change in GamesView.swift where BetSlipSheet is presented

userStories.title: Remove Quick-Pick Stake Buttons
userStories.description: As a player, I want a cleaner stake entry without preset amount buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: In BetSlipSheet.swift stakeEntrySection, remove the quick-pick buttons HStack (ForEach with PremiumQuickPickButton)
Keep the custom amount input field ($ text field with Theme styling)
Optionally remove PremiumQuickPickButton struct if no longer used elsewhere
Stake section now shows only the text input field
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Remove the HStack with ForEach(BetSlipManager.quickPickAmounts) in stakeEntrySection

userStories.title: Add Per-Item Stake Storage to BetSlipManager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store individual stakes per bet item for singles mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Add itemStakes dictionary [UUID: Decimal] to BetSlipManager to store per-item stakes
Add methods: setItemStake(marketId: UUID, stake: Decimal), getItemStake(marketId: UUID) -> Decimal
Add computed property individualTotalStake that sums all item stakes
Add computed property individualTotalPayout that calculates total payout from individual stakes
When an item is removed, also remove its stake from itemStakes
When clearAll() is called, also clear itemStakes
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Modify BetSlipManager.swift - foundation for per-bet stakes in singles mode

userStories.title: Add Stake Input to Bet Cards in Singles Mode
userStories.description: As a player betting singles, I want to enter a different stake for each bet individually.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify PremiumBetSlipItemCard to accept betMode and stake binding parameters
When betMode == .singles, show stake input field on each bet card
Stake input styled consistently ($ prefix, Theme.elevatedBackground, gold border when focused)
Show individual potential payout on each card based on that bet's stake and odds
Changes to stake update BetSlipManager.itemStakes via the binding
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Modify PremiumBetSlipItemCard struct to support inline stake entry

userStories.title: Restructure Bet Slip with Sticky Bottom Section
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to restructure the bet slip layout with scrollable top and sticky bottom.
acceptanceCriteria: Restructure selectionsList to separate scrollable content from sticky bottom
Scrollable area contains: header with count, Singles/Parlay toggle, bet cards, parlay odds card (if parlay)
Create stickyBottomSection view builder for bottom content
Use VStack with Spacer or safeAreaInset to position sticky section at bottom
Add subtle divider (Rectangle with Theme.divider or subtle shadow) between scroll area and sticky section
Sticky section has Theme.cardBackground background
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Major layout restructure - keep all existing components, just reorganize positioning

userStories.title: Configure Sticky Section Content by Mode
userStories.description: As a player, I want the sticky section to show appropriate controls based on bet mode.
acceptanceCriteria: When betMode == .parlay: sticky section shows stake input, potential payout, Place Bet button
When betMode == .singles: sticky section shows total stake summary, total payout, Place Bet button
Stake validation warning appears in sticky section when applicable
Place Bet button uses existing submitSection styling
canSubmit logic works correctly for both modes
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Conditional rendering in stickyBottomSection based on betSlipManager.betMode

userStories.title: Update Submission Logic for Per-Bet Stakes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to update bet submission to use individual stakes for singles mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify submitBets() to read from itemStakes for singles mode
For each item in singles mode, get stake from betSlipManager.getItemStake(item.marketId)
Parlay mode continues to use the shared betSlipManager.stake
Each bet submitted with its correct individual stake amount
Success count and error handling work correctly with new stake structure
Project builds and runs in Simulator
